title: Speed at B
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the block's speed at point B using work-energy theorem with friction and electric force.

title: Minimum speed at D
description: Essential: Correctly determines the minimum speed at the top of the circle using Newton's second law for circular motion.

title: Maximum electric field
description: Important: Applies work-energy theorem from A to D to find the maximum electric field strength for the block to reach D with the required speed.

title: Projectile motion analysis
description: Important: Correctly resolves the velocity at D and uses kinematics to find the projectile's time of flight and horizontal displacement.

title: Geometric landing condition
description: Important: Uses the geometry of the track and landing point to find the horizontal distance from the projection of D to the electric field boundary.

title: Length of BC
description: Essential: Correctly sums the projectile and geometric horizontal displacements to find the total length of segment BC.

title: Force component error
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly resolves the gravitational or electric force components on the incline, or omits the electric force in the normal force calculation.

title: Sign or energy error
description: Pitfall: Makes sign errors in the work-energy equation (e.g., for friction or electric work) or misapplies conservation of energy in non-conservative regions.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units throughout the calculation and presents final answers with correct units.
